desktop.notesZh: 批次二十三（会话框控件的字形同族化 + tooltip 改名「格式化输入」，web 端真机探针 30 项断言全 PASS）：① 需求——恢复按钮图标样式要和美化按钮保持风格一致；按钮的 hover 文字改为「格式化输入」。② 根因——上一批的回退态用的是平台 `refresh-outline`（圆弧箭头，纯 1.3px 描边、整格圆弧），而美化态用的是 `list-pen-outline`（文档实体 + 实心笔），两者形状语言与视觉密度都不同，放在一起像两个产品；而且 `refresh-outline` 在本产品里一律表示「重试 / 刷新」（插件检查、附件重试），用它当「回退」连语义都是错的。③ 做法——给平台图标集补一枚缺失字形 `undo-doc-outline`：复用平台自己的文档体（`browse-outline` 的那一段 path），把笔的位置换成**实心向左箭头**，于是「文档+笔（正在整理）」与「文档+←（可以退回）」读作同一个物件的两个状态，字重、填充语言、包围盒全部一致。字形落在 `packages/client/ui-primitives/src/icons/artwork.ts`，随 `ICON_SYMBOLS` 自动进入 ui-theme 的图标 sprite，可被主题替换。④ tooltip——美化态 hover 文案由「按 Markdown 整理结构，不改写你写的字」改为「格式化输入」（en: Format the input）；回退态文案不变（还原美化前的原文 / 会丢弃美化之后的修改），因为那一侧需要说清后果。⑤ 门禁——ui-baf-desktop 36 例（新增 1 例锁定「格式化态=list-pen、回退态=undo-doc」的字形对）、ui-primitives + ui-theme 图标集 549 例全绿；平台图标数量断言由 96 枚同步为 97 枚（192 → 194 个导出）。
desktop.notesEn: Batch 23 (the composer control's glyph pair now reads as one object, and the tidy-up tooltip reads "格式化输入" / "Format the input"; the live web probe passed all 30 assertions): ① Requirement — the revert button's icon must keep the same visual style as the tidy-up button, and the button's hover text becomes "格式化输入". ② Root cause — the previous revert state used the platform `refresh-outline` (a circular arrow, pure 1.3px hairline, filling the whole box) while the tidy-up state used `list-pen-outline` (a solid document with a pen). The two disagree in shape language and visual density, so they read as different products; worse, `refresh-outline` means "retry / refresh" everywhere else in this product (plugin check, attachment retry), so it was semantically wrong for "revert" too. ③ Fix — a new platform glyph `undo-doc-outline`: it reuses the platform's own document body (the path `browse-outline` draws) and replaces the pen with a solid left arrow, so "document + pen (being arranged)" and "document + ← (can be restored)" read as two states of one object, matching in weight, fill language, and bounding box. The glyph lives in `packages/client/ui-primitives/src/icons/artwork.ts` and enters the ui-theme icon sprite automatically through `ICON_SYMBOLS`, so a theme can still replace it. ④ Copy — the tidy-up tooltip changed from "按 Markdown 整理结构，不改写你写的字" to "格式化输入" (en: "Format the input"); the revert copy is unchanged (restore the draft from before the tidy-up / discards the edits made after it), because that side has to state the consequence. ⑤ Gates — 36 ui-baf-desktop cases (one new case locks the format=list-pen / revert=undo-doc glyph pair), 549 icon-set cases green; the platform's hardcoded glyph count moved from 96 to 97 (192 → 194 exports).
